sections.title: Core words and phrases
sections.description: Flip each card, listen, and create one personal example.

cards.definition: Our plan is to travel in June.
I have an arrangement with my tutor.
We need to book a room.

tip.title: Recall practice
tip.text: Cover the English term, read the Vietnamese meaning, and retrieve the full phrase from memory.

sections.title: Grammar bridge
sections.description: Master the structures that connect this A2 module to the next stage.

points.title: Be going to
points.function: Use it for intentions and predictions based on evidence.
examples: I am going to study tonight.
Look at those clouds! It is going to rain.

points.title: Present continuous
points.function: Use it for a fixed future arrangement.
examples: I am meeting Hoa at six.

points.title: Will
points.function: Use it for instant decisions, offers and general predictions.
examples: I think people will travel more.

tip.title: Accuracy first
tip.text: Notice the verb form in every example, then change the subject or time expression to make a new sentence.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.description: Choose the best answer, then read the explanation.

questions.explanation: A fixed arrangement uses the present continuous.

questions.prompt: Look at the sky. It ___ rain.
questions.explanation: Evidence now supports a going-to prediction.

questions.prompt: The phone is ringing. I ___ answer it.
questions.explanation: Use will for an instant decision. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: We ___ a hotel for next weekend.
questions.explanation: A completed arrangement can use present perfect.
Available means free to meet. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

questions.prompt: She is looking forward ___ the concert.
questions.explanation: The phrase is look forward to. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

tip.title: Use the clue
tip.text: Look for time expressions, the subject, and words before or after the gap before choosing.

sections.title: Listening: Making Weekend Plans
sections.description: Listen to two friends arranging a time and place to meet.

audio.transcript: Are you free this Saturday, Emma? There's a food festival in the town square. I'd love to go, but I'm visiting my grandmother in the morning. What time does the festival start? It opens at ten and finishes at six. How about meeting at the station at two? I have a dentist appointment at half past one, so could we meet at three instead? That's fine. The weather forecast says it may rain, so I'll bring an umbrella. Great. I'll book our train tickets tonight.

options: A visit to a food festival
gistQuestions.explanation: They are deciding when to meet for the food festival.

detailQuestions.explanation: They finally agree to meet at three. Read the complete context before rejecting the other options.

detailQuestions.prompt: What will one speaker book tonight?
detailQuestions.explanation: The final plan is to book their train tickets.

tip.title: Listening Tip
tip.text: The first time you hear a time may not be the final arrangement. Listen for changes such as instead.

sections.title: Build a spoken answer
sections.description: Answer each question aloud. Aim for a clear answer plus one reason or detail.
questions: What are you doing this weekend?
What are you going to learn next?
What do you think life will be like in ten years?
sections.sampleAnswer: I am meeting some friends on Saturday. We are going to try a new restaurant. On Sunday, I will probably stay home and prepare for next week.

tip.title: Speak in layers
tip.text: Start with a direct answer, add a reason, then give one example or detail.

sections.title: Independent writing
sections.description: Arrange a weekend activity with a friend.

prompt.situation: Suggest a plan, give a time and place, and offer an alternative.
prompt.referenceAnswer: I am meeting some friends on Saturday. We are going to try a new restaurant. On Sunday, I will probably stay home and prepare for next week.

tip.title: Final check
tip.text: Check verb forms, word order, spelling, and whether every sentence helps answer the task.
